review.algorithm_assessment: Root the tree at node 1 as shown by the task. Compute original root-to-node sums and an iterative DFS Euler interval for each subtree. Changing one node sweetness by delta changes exactly the root-path sums of its descendants, so apply delta to its contiguous Euler interval with a Fenwick difference array. Each type-1 answer is its original path sum plus the point delta. Type-2 is assignment, not increment. Iterative traversal avoids recursion failures on a 10000-node chain; zero sweetness in the published sample is supported.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
